content.comment_body: How can I disable a message on the [product_name] display? I know it can be activated by switching input En of Message Text from 0 to 1, but how can it be deactivated within the program? Please note: I need to do this on an older [product_name] - [article_no] version, which doesn't support all modern functions.
To deactivate the message, switch the input En of Message Text from 1 to 0. Additionally, in the parameter settings of the text block, set "acknowledge message" output to OFF.
